messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx & gateway timeouts on /v1/generate (svc: gateway-prod) — 5xx rate 7.8% in 5m window, p95 latency 2.1s (baseline 120ms). Paging SRE oncall @oncall-rosa :rotating_light:

oncall-rosa: acked, joining. I'm pulling logs from the gateway and scheduler now. who's on runtime?

sre-aaron: I'm here, looking at scheduler metrics — queue_length for batching-scheduler is 18k, avg batch wait 1.6s, tail waits > 6s. lots of HOL blocking visible on node pool gpu-pool-4.

eng-maya: I see a handful of very long-running requests pinned in the KV-cache warmups — a few requests with seq_len ~32k are holding open batches. That matches the HOL pattern.

oncall-rosa: Customer impact? any specific clients getting errors?

support-oliver: Support reports spike in errors for customer "AtlasSearch" and several PLG signups. Error sample from gateway: `{"error":"gateway timeout","req_id":"req_8f3a2"}`. AtlasSearch has ~12k failed requests in the window.

eng-runtime-chen: Quick mitigation options: 1) scale up gpu-pool-4 by 50% (adds capacity but slow), 2) enable per-route small-model fallback for heavy requests, 3) enable HOL eviction on scheduler to preempt very long sequences, 4) disable batching for /v1/generate for 2 min.

sre-aaron: Scaling attempt queued — autoscaler currently at 80% CPU; manual scale to add 8 nodes, doing now: `k8s scale deployment gpu-pool-4 --replicas=24`

eng-maya: While that starts, I'm going to disable batching for the public route to break head-of-line. Command: `redwoodctl routes update /v1/generate --batching=false --reason "urgent-hol-mitigation"`

support-oliver: Noted. We should send a brief customer message: "We're mitigating timeouts; you may see increased latency as we reroute. No action required on your side."

product-liz: Agree — short message and promise of update in 30m. Also please capture which customers were impacted for post-incident follow-up.

oncall-rosa: Batching disabled, confirmed: route /v1/generate -> batching=false. Immediate drop in HOL queue length by ~30% visible in dashboard. Gateway 5xx rate down to 3.2% (5m).

eng-runtime-chen: Autoscale finished, new nodes registered, but existing long requests still occupy some slots. HOL eviction toggle is safe to flip — prepping to enable `scheduler.preempt_long_sequences=true`

eng-maya: Enabling preemption now. Patch: `PATCH /config/scheduler {"preempt_long_sequences":true, "threshold_ms":2500}`. Monitoring.

sre-aaron: Preemption took effect, seeing several long requests evicted and retried on fallback path. p95 latency trending down to 480ms, 5xx at 1.1% now.

support-oliver: AtlasSearch errors decreased by ~78% after batching off + preemption. They're reporting intermittent slow responses but no more timeouts.

oncall-rosa: OK good. Next steps: keep batching disabled for 15min while we let the cluster absorb load, then re-enable with stricter max_seq_len and per-request timeout. Who owns re-enable?

eng-maya: I'll re-enable and add max_seq_len=4096 on route and per-request timeout 30s. Plan: re-enable in 15m if 5xx < 0.5% and queue_length < 3k.

product-liz: Notify customers at 30m with a short summary and ETA for postmortem.

eng-runtime-chen: Creating follow-up ticket for runtime: TRACK-1321 — investigate why some requests allowed seq_len 32k, propose validation and admission control.

oncall-rosa: Handoff: @sre-aaron will stay as primary for now, I'll hand to @sre-aaron for continuing ops. I'll remain reachable for customer comms.

sre-aaron: staying on. Logging timeline + commands executed to the incident channel.

support-oliver: Sending customer note now.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in progress — batching disabled, preemption enabled, cluster scaled. Severity reduced. Next update in 15m or when conditions meet re-enable criteria.

eng-maya: After 10m check: 5xx at 0.4%, p95 160ms, queue_length 900. Safe to schedule re-enable soon.

eng-maya: Re-enabling batching with conservative settings: `redwoodctl routes update /v1/generate --batching=true --max_seq_len=4096 --batch_timeout_ms=20`

oncall-rosa: Re-enable done. Monitoring closely. No regression seen in first 3 minutes.

product-liz: Great work. Please ensure postmortem captures customer impact numbers, root cause (missing admission control for oversized sequences + batching interaction), and action items (route validation, admission limits, automated HOL eviction).

sre-aaron: Final state at last check: 5xx steady at 0.08%, p95 130ms, queue_length stable. Closing live handoff. Will create incident report and tag ops/reliability/runtime for follow-up.

support-oliver: Closing customer tickets where appropriate, adding notes.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: root cause suspected: unbounded long-sequence requests causing head-of-line blocking in batcher. Follow-up: TRACK-1321 (runtime admission control), TRACK-1322 (customer opt-in validation), POSTMORTEM-202613.

oncall-rosa: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the postmortem template and small blameless writeup.
